changelog: Adopsi Mesin ICT Concepts amygmgo & Dashboard V2: Matriks status bias M15 16-baris autoritatif, Dealing Range (Premium/Discount/EQ), DOL & POI tracking komprehensif.

AMY Entry Assistant V3: Deteksi 4 sinyal presisi (Buy/Sell Entry, Pullback Buy/Sell) berbasis Break + Retest + Reject (wick 1.2x), Math Zones (Fibo OTE 0.618-0.786, SNR, Sweeps), dan Anti-Chase Filter.
Weekend Stitching & Anti-Cold-Start: Menghubungkan candle penutupan Jumat sore dengan pembukaan Minggu secara sah tanpa error data terlambat.
Optimasi Kuota TwelveData & Zero Supabase: Penambahan multi-tier local persistent candle cache dan CDN edge cache anti-429.
